classification: Optional paid Swap Intent journeys: paired schema-v3 Pre-Trade gates, settlement-gated receipt credit, and caller-held outcome reporting
receiptImpact: Existing OracleSafetyCheck v3 and ExecutionReceipt signed layouts, registry release, attester keys, partner policies, and activation set v6 remain unchanged. Insight adds an optional same-chain x402 Swap Intent that binds two independently signed v3 Pre-Trade gates to an opaque journey. A caller can redeem one Execution Receipt only after x402 settlement and the existing execution-proof verification succeeds. Venue and router values are caller claims, not verified venue facts; a missing callback is never treated as proof of non-execution.
activationRule: The Swap Intent path is available only to a caller that completes the paid same-chain intent and retains its one-time outcome capability. Receipt issuance remains bound to the two signed gate UIDs and an independently verified settlement transaction. This promotion grants no partner activation, partner reliance, execution or broadcast authority, Stage 2 change, new attester key, or new data-source authority.
